# Original mapped-output boundary fixture

`mapped-original.gooo.fixture` preserves the exact source in
[issue #1620](https://github.com/kimjooyoon/meta-ontology-go/issues/1620), SHA256
`1c23bfc07dfb68b5d03b762a572f790dcb43f2546b312dd8d02ae3ab909bdab5`.
The BSD notice is retained in `LICENSE`. Paths in its historical comments refer
to the original experiment directory. The immutable Go reference remains linked
in the issue.

The new test declares a 1,030-byte canonical field before execution, preserves
all original field IDs and the unchanged zone, then compares all thirteen typed
values through the public CLI. The fixture implements one mapped-address output
example. It does not supply a general address parser.
